We performed human evaluation on the most promising LSTM and Transformer speaker models using the Amazon Mechanical Turk (AMT) crowdsourcing platform, in order to analyze whether group descriptions were preferred over instance descriptions for describing a group of image instances.
guideline: select the description(s) that best describe all or most of the images in the group in a forced-choice task with 3 options: (A) the generated discriminative group description, (B) the generated instance description, or (C) both.

Participants were shown all images of the target group and two competing descriptions (group description and instance description) and asked to choose which description best describes all or most images (option A, B, or both).
We asked them to carefully observe the images and select the description(s) that best describe all or most of the images in the group in a forced-choice task with 3 options, (A), (B) or (C) both.
